description: This file defines the 'GridLayer' class for the Leaflet mapping library, handling tiled grid layers with options for tile size, opacity, zoom levels, and tile management. It includes methods for creating, updating, and removing tiles, as well as managing layer z-index and opacity.

classes.name: GridLayer
classes.description: A class extending Layer that manages a tiled grid of HTML elements, with options for tile size, opacity, zoom levels, and tile management, including methods for creating, updating, and pruning tiles.

methods.name: createTile
methods.description: Method to create a tile element; meant to be overridden by subclasses. Defaults to creating a 'div' element.

methods.name: getTileSize
methods.description: Returns the tile size as a Point object, normalized from options.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the entire grid layer.

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Sets the z-index of the grid layer.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Returns true if any tiles are still loading.

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Removes all tiles and requests them again to refresh the layer.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map interactions like view reset, move end, zoom, and optional zoom animation.

methods.name: _initContainer
methods.description: Initializes the container DOM element for tiles.

methods.name: _updateZIndex
methods.description: Updates the z-index style of the container.

methods.name: _setAutoZIndex
methods.description: Automatically sets z-index based on other layers in the same pane.

methods.name: _updateOpacity
methods.description: Animates opacity changes for tiles.

methods.name: _invalidateAll
methods.description: Removes all levels and tiles, resetting the layer.

methods.name: _retainParent
methods.description: Recursively retains parent tiles for better zoom transitions.

methods.name: _retainChildren
methods.description: Recursively retains child tiles for zoom levels.

methods.name: _resetView
methods.description: Resets the view based on map events.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Handles zoom animations.

methods.name: _clampZoom
methods.description: Clamps zoom level within native zoom bounds.

methods.name: _setView
methods.description: Sets the view, updates levels, grid, and tiles accordingly.

methods.name: _setZoomTransforms
methods.description: Applies zoom transforms to all levels.

methods.name: _setZoomTransform
methods.description: Applies zoom transform to a specific level.

methods.name: _resetGrid
methods.description: Resets grid parameters based on map size and CRS.

methods.name: _onMoveEnd
methods.description: Updates tiles after map move ends.

methods.name: _getTiledPixelBounds
methods.description: Calculates pixel bounds for the current tile grid.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Loads and manages tiles within current map bounds and zoom.

methods.name: _isValidTile
methods.description: Checks if a tile coordinate is valid within map bounds and options.

methods.name: _keyToBounds
methods.description: Converts a tile cache key to geographical bounds.

methods.name: _tileCoordsToNwSe
methods.description: Converts tile coordinates to northwest and southeast geographical points.

methods.name: _tileCoordsToBounds
methods.description: Converts tile coordinates to geographical bounds.

methods.name: _tileCoordsToKey
methods.description: Converts tile coordinates to a cache key string.

methods.name: _keyToTileCoords
methods.description: Converts a cache key string back to tile coordinates.

methods.name: _removeTile
methods.description: Removes a tile element from DOM and cache.

methods.name: _initTile
methods.description: Initializes a tile element with classes and styles.

methods.name: _addTile
methods.description: Creates and adds a tile element to the container.

methods.name: _tileReady
methods.description: Handles tile load completion, errors, and firing events.

methods.name: _getTilePos
methods.description: Calculates pixel position for a tile.

methods.name: _wrapCoords
methods.description: Wraps tile coordinates according to map CRS.

methods.name: _pxBoundsToTileRange
methods.description: Converts pixel bounds to tile coordinate range.

methods.name: _noTilesToLoad
methods.description: Checks if all tiles have finished loading.
